answer.reason: Pirathon is the place where the judge Abdon was buried (JDG 12:15); the other verses only use it as a demonym in lists.

clauses.english: was where Abdon the judge of Israel was buried
clauses.quote: was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim

doubts: The mentions of Benaiah the Pirathonite in 2SA 23:30, 1CH 11:31 and 1CH 27:14 only list him by his home town, so they were not used.
Abdon's judging of Israel in JDG 12:13 is a deed of the person, not an event of the place.
